title: Route Exception Authorization Form
subtitle: Route Exception: bounds the decision, conditions, and expiry.
description: Route Exception Authorization Form binds route event, vehicle, stop, shipment, delay, safety condition, and recovery plan to a named transport decision, commercial or operating limit, effective time, and the dispatch / customer authority's confirmation. The dispatch exception coordinator records the requested Route Exception action and keeps any variance outside the granted authority.
use_case: Use Route Exception Authorization Form at current safe location, planned route, affected stop, alternate route, and return point. Reconcile applicable Route Exception requirements with the load, carrier, rate, claim, equipment, document, or inventory boundary that applies. Capture the dispatch / customer authority's approval, counteroffer, hold, or decline, then reauthorize any change to route event, vehicle, stop, shipment, delay, safety condition, and recovery plan.

sections.title: Authorization request and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Route Exception, identify responsible parties, current safe location, planned route, affected stop, alternate route, and return point, and the linked route event, vehicle, stop, shipment, delay, safety condition, and recovery plan source.

fields.label: Event time, location, and service commitment

sections.title: Requested scope, limits, and decision lines
sections.guidance: Capture Route Exception facts for route event, vehicle, stop, shipment, delay, safety condition, and recovery plan; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Route Exception authorization checks
items: Exception type and immediate safety state
Vehicle, cargo, driver, road, weather, and customer impact
Last completed and next affected stop
Reroute, rescue, transfer, return, or wait option

sections.title: Authorization conditions and final decision
sections.guidance: Resolve open Route Exception conditions; have dispatch exception coordinator assign the next Route Exception owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Decision limits, holds, and retained evidence
blocks.guidance: Pause Route Exception when safe location, driver fitness, vehicle condition, cargo custody, or authorized recovery remains unresolved. Retain the available Route Exception proof and route unresolved route event, vehicle, stop, shipment, delay, safety condition, and recovery plan scope to dispatch exception coordinator.
